services.description: Official document certifying the annual household income of an individual or family for welfare schemes, school/college fee concessions, and government quotas.
services.eligibility: Resident of the state with verifiable legal income sources. Household income limits vary by scheme.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit application with ID and proof of residence. 2. Field verification by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or Revenue Inspector. 3. Final issuance by Tahsildar.
services.source: National e-Governance Division (NeGD) Citizen Services Portal

services.description: Official legal proof validating an applicant's continuous residency within a specific state, district, or taluk for education or employment reservations.
services.eligibility: Applicant must have continuously resided in the state/district for a minimum continuous duration (typically 5 to 7 years) or have ancestral domicile.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Fill citizen details. 2. Attach address and residence continuous proofs. 3. Revenue inspection and Tahsildar digital signature.

services.department: Department of Higher Education & Social Welfare
services.description: Financial assistance and tuition fee reimbursement for meritorious students from economically weaker sections and reserved social communities.
services.eligibility: Enrolled in recognized higher education institution (UG/PG/Diploma). Parent annual income within scheme caps (e.g., under INR 2,50,000 for full waiver).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online student registration. 2. Verification of marksheets and institutional bonafide by college nodal officer. 3. Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) sanction.

services.department: Department of Social Welfare & Backward Classes
services.description: Government statutory certificate confirming the social community, caste, or tribe of the citizen to claim constitutional affirmative action benefits.
services.eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or Most Backward Class (MBC) as recognized in the state gazette.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with parental blood-relative records. 2. Spot enquiry and community register check. 3. Issuance by competent Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Tahsildar.
services.source: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment e-Services Manual

services.department: Department of Public Health & Municipal Administration
services.description: Primary legal record of a person's birth, including date, location, and parentage details vital for all civil rights and identity credentials.
services.eligibility: Any birth occurring within the jurisdiction of the municipal corporation, municipality, or village panchayat.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Hospital Form-1 birth intimation within 21 days of delivery. 2. Medical officer verification. 3. Issuance by Registrar of Births and Deaths.
services.source: Civil Registration System (CRS) - Office of the Registrar General

services.department: Department of Social Security & Disability Welfare
services.description: Monthly financial pension grant provided to senior citizens living in economic distress or without sufficient family financial support.
services.eligibility: Citizen aged 60 years or older. Family income below official Below Poverty Line (BPL) threshold. No adult earning member providing sustained support.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with proof of age and BPL card. 2. Verification of physical living condition and bank account. 3. Monthly DBT pension authorization.

services.description: Central and state government subsidized housing initiative providing pucca homes or construction assistance to homeless and kutcha-house dwellers.
services.eligibility: Citizen/family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Income category: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) or Low Income Group (LIG).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Household registration and geo-tagged home survey. 2. Land title verification. 3. Direct milestone fund transfer into beneficiary bank account.
services.source: Housing For All Urban & Rural Mission Guidelines 2026

services.department: Ministry of Education - Higher Education Financing Authority
services.description: Scheme offering full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period plus one year) on educational loans taken for professional/technical courses.
services.eligibility: Admitted to recognized technical/professional degree. Total parental/family income from all sources not exceeding INR 4,50,000 per annum.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Avail education loan from scheduled commercial bank. 2. Submit income certificate and bonafide to lending branch. 3. Ministry subsidy credit.
services.source: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) Portal
